name: Soft Spectrum
source:
Unemployment among people with autism is very high, with figures ranging from 76% to 90%. This makes autism the disability with the highest unemployment rate, so this game wants to give insight into the real difficulties that can arise for someone who is on the spectrum. Sofia, a sheep who has ASD, must face her first job interview.

[From [url=https://invideogames-bootcamp.itch.io/soft-spectrum]itch.io[/url]]
